subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
A single side band signal is generated by modulating 
signal of 900 kHz carrier by the signal m(t) = cos 2000
t + 2 sin 2000 t. The amplitude of the carrier is AC 
= 100. The lower sideband of the SSB AM signal is  
 
 (a) –100 cos[2 (fc – 1000)t] 
 
 
 
+ 200 sin[2 (fc –1000)t]
 
 
 
(b) – 100 cos[2π (fc – 1000)t] 
– 200 sin[2π(fc  – 1000)t]
 
 
 
(c) 50 cos [2π(fc – 1000)t] 
– 100 sin [2π(fc – 1000)t]
 
 
 
(d) 50 cos [2π (fc –1000)t] 
+ 100 sin[2π(fc – 1000)t]
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
